items.title: Advantages: Scalability, Accessibility, and Cost-effectiveness (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Advantages: Scalability, Accessibility, and Cost-effectiveness (PDF 111, printed 107).

blocks.text: Cloud computing ka ek bara faida scalability hai: users zaroorat ke mutabiq apni storage aur computing power aasani se barha ya ghata sakte hain, jo barhte karobar aur idaron ke liye behtareen hai. Doosra faida accessibility (rasai) hai: cloud services se users mukhtalif devices aur jagahon se kaam kar sakte hain, files haath se muntaqil kiye baghair.

Cloud computing kam kharch (cost-effective) bhi hai, kyunke mehenge servers aur maintenance staff ki zaroorat kam ho jati hai. Users aam tor par sirf utni services ki qeemat dete hain jitni use karein (pay-as-you-go model), jis se chalane ka kharch kam hota hai. In fawaid ki wajah se cloud technology un logon aur companies ke liye mufeed hai jinhein qabil-e-bharosa aur kaar-amad digital hal chahiye.

blocks.caption: Cloud ke teen fawaid
rows: Zaroorat ke mutabiq storage aur computing power barhana ya ghatana
Kai devices aur jagahon se kaam; files haath se muntaqil (transfer) nahi karni
Mehenge servers aur staff ki zaroorat kam; pay-as-you-go: jitna use utni qeemat

blocks.text: Pay-as-you-go model mein aap sirf utni storage ki qeemat dete hain jitni use karte hain. Yeh chhota program teen mahinon ka cloud bill banata hai aur apna server khareedne se muqabla karta hai (qeematein sirf misal hain).

gb_used = [50, 80, 120]        # teen mahinon ki storage (GB)
price_per_gb = 6               # PKR fi GB har mahine (misal)
own_server_cost = 150000       # apna server khareedne ka kharch (PKR, misal)

total = 0
for month, gb in enumerate(gb_used, start=1):
    bill = gb * price_per_gb
    total += bill
    print(f"Mahina {month}: {gb} GB x {price_per_gb} = PKR {bill}")

print("Teen mahine ka cloud kharch: PKR", total)
print("Apna server: PKR", own_server_cost)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"gb_used = [50, 80, 120]": teen mahinon mein kitne GB istemal hue; storage barhti gayi (yahi scalability hai).
"price_per_gb = 6": aik GB ki mahana qeemat (misal). "own_server_cost = 150000": apna server khareedne ka kharch (misal).
"total = 0": shuru mein kul kharch sifar.
"for month, gb in enumerate(gb_used, start=1)": har mahine ki storage bari bari; "bill = gb * price_per_gb" us mahine ka bill; "total += bill" bill ko kul mein jama karta hai.
f-string ke {} mein variables ki value aa jati hai.
Output: "Mahina 1: 50 GB x 6 = PKR 300", "Mahina 2: 80 GB x 6 = PKR 480", "Mahina 3: 120 GB x 6 = PKR 720", phir "Teen mahine ka cloud kharch: PKR 1500" aur "Apna server: PKR 150000".
Khud try karein: gb_used mein chautha mahina (maslan 200) daal kar dekhein ke bill kaise barhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Aik naya online store pehle mahine 50 GB aur teesre mahine 120 GB storage use karta hai. Cloud ke kaun se do fawaid is ke kaam aate hain?
blocks.explanation: Scalability: storage zaroorat ke mutabiq barh jati hai, naya server nahi khareedna parta. Cost-effectiveness: pay-as-you-go mein sirf use ki hui storage ki qeemat. (Accessibility bhi: store wale kisi bhi device se kaam kar sakte hain.)

items: Scalability, accessibility aur cost-effectiveness (pay-as-you-go) cloud ke bare fawaid hain.
